sap_tools.summary: [runtime] List SAP Gateway error log (/IWFND/ERROR_LOG) or get error detail. Returns structured entries with type, shortText, transactionId, dateTime, username. With error_url returns full detail including serviceInfo, errorContext, sourceCode, callStack.

sap_tools.name: mcp__sap_abap_adt__RuntimeGetProfilerTraceData
sap_tools.summary: [runtime] Read profiler trace data by trace id/uri: hitlist, statements, or db accesses. Returns parsed JSON payload.

sap_tools.name: mcp__sap_abap_adt__RuntimeRunProgramWithProfiling
sap_tools.summary: [runtime] Execute ABAP program with profiler enabled and return created profilerId + traceId.
